title: Mexico City tacos: 15 taquerias by neighborhood
desc: Fifteen taco stands and taquerias across Mexico City, grouped by neighborhood from Narvarte and Roma to Juarez, Condesa and Centro.

items.title: Tacos Los Caramelos
items.memo: Asada taco on a flour tortilla, on the Narvarte and Roma Sur edge.

items.title: La Taquiza al Carbon
items.memo: Al pastor carved from the trompo in Narvarte.

items.title: Tacos Tony
items.memo: Ask for the suadero en trozo (in chunks).

items.title: Tacos Beto
items.memo: Suadero and longaniza cooked on a comal de bola.

items.title: Tacos El Gato Volador
items.memo: Open 24 hours; try the chupa, a mix of fillings.

items.title: Birria Estilo Jalisco
items.memo: Birria tacos plus consome from a stand running since 1992.

items.title: Tacos La Soledad
items.memo: Campechano with a choice of quesillo or provolone.

items.title: El Turuleto
items.memo: Seafood tacos; the Galan is a creamy shrimp taco.

items.title: Porcino
items.memo: House-smoked pork tacos, just north of Juarez in San Rafael.

items.title: Barbacoa Dani
items.memo: Lamb barbacoa; order the espalda (back) cut.

items.title: Taqueria El Torito
items.memo: Suadero and tripa campechano, serving since 1957.

items.title: Tacos de Canasta Don Kaly
items.memo: Basket tacos; the mole verde one is the pick.
